about_the_game:
In Wolf With Inn you will become a werewolf, who shares a body with the Beast. But you're not here to help adventurers—you're here for the ones they fear: demons, mermaids, and other so-called "monsters."

Explore the mysteries of Mystmoor Forest, grow your tavern, cook exquisite meals and drinks, unlock new recipes, go fishing, and gather rare ingredients through a variety of mini-games. Uncover story-rich quests and meet a cast of strange, unforgettable characters.

Will you befriend your shadow and build a bridge between those who have long forgotten how to speak to one another?

Let the monsters give the adventurers what they deserve

You're a werewolf—so why would you side with the adventurers hunting down your kin? Protect those they call monsters: demons, mermaids, and other forest dwellers. And if a hero shows up… let the forest handle them.

Mini-games galore

Go fishing, gather mushrooms, chop wood, grind grain! Pour drinks and throw out rowdy guests—plenty of fun and satisfying mini-games await you!

Explore by day, run the tavern by night

During the day, explore Mystmoor, complete story-driven quests, and gather ingredients for the evening's menu. When night falls, take your place behind the bar—serve meals, pour drinks, and calm down rowdy guests.

Unique characters and a compelling story

Travel through the biomes of a rich fantasy world, meet memorable characters, and help build bridges between the villagers and the ones they call "monsters."

Grow with your tavern

Learn new recipes, upgrade your skills, and unlock new mechanics and abilities as your journey unfolds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 или AMD Phenom II X4
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 450 / AMD Radeon HD 6570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K или AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R9 270
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

short_description: Wolf With Inn is a cozy fantasy tavern simulator. Become a werewolf, discover new recipes, cook hearty meals, and grow your inn! Welcome noble white knights and adventurers—and send them into the clutches of the forest "monsters."
